intro: StorageCafe has no industry-statistics page for Aberdeen, and the listings table is not split by climate control. The all-unit-types 10x10 average is $39/month (September 2026). StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city, and Storage Stats has no market page for it, so that StorageCafe figure is the advertised rate. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe listings all-unit-types averages; no climate split and no industry-statistics page); no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page

units.notes: Most rented size. Listings-page all-unit-types average $39 (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). The table is not split into non-climate and climate-controlled rates. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Storage Stats does not publish a market page for this city.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe listings all-unit-types average $49 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe listings all-unit-types average $79 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size.

local_tips: Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
